∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x)) (k : ℕ),
      BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A (R.H (k + 1)) =
        BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A (R.H k))
          (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A (R.H k))
            (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.projectedGradient A F R k) (R.α k))
          (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.projectedGradient A F R (k + 1) -
            BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.projectedGradient A F R k)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (H : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (s : BfgsVerification.Vec n)
  (y : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A (BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H s (A.transpose.mulVec y)) =
    BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A H) (A.mulVec s) y

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ (R : BfgsVerification.FullBFGSRun n) (gbar : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Vec r),
      (∀ (k : ℕ), A.transpose.mulVec (gbar k) = R.g k) →
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          R.H k * A.transpose =
            BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.lift A (R.H 0) * BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A (R.H k)
